thesis: August 4 was a cost-drag loss rather than a gross trading loss. All 11 closed positions were Rangebound Reversion: INR 74.24 gross became INR -487.14 net after INR 561.38 of charges. Target exits worked, but stop, VWAP, and signal-deterioration losses consumed their gains. The trailing window also continues to show Momentum Runner as the largest recurring setup-level drag even though it opened no position on August 4.

selectedDay.exitSummary: Four Target exits earned INR 752.19 net. Three Stop exits lost INR 641.90, two VWAP exits lost INR 359.14, and three Momentum / Signal exits lost INR 238.29. Stored day-close benchmarks cover every exit but are not executable counterfactuals.

limitations: This is analytics-reviewed only. No Replay, backtest, sweep, or targeted settings trial was run.
August 4 has 200 snapshots, 188 usable snapshots, and one settings fingerprint. Repeated snapshot appearances were not treated as independent observations.
July 30 and July 31 have lower usable snapshot coverage and multiple historical settings fingerprints, reducing direct comparability.
Transactions do not store the entry-time expected gross-to-cost multiple, so the exact trades affected by tightening the Rangebound cost gate cannot be identified.
Day-close opportunity values measure hindsight distance from the recorded exit, not an executable later exit.

topGainerSelectionAnalysis.conclusion: Top-gainer rank was only an annotation and did not bypass setup qualification. No captured top-five rejection was caused by cash, capacity, max-open, cooldown, or trade-limit controls. The dominant blockers were score floors, weak breadth, unconfirmed triggers, excessive extension, fading five-minute momentum, and late cutoffs.

topGainerSelectionAnalysis.dataCaveat: Captured ranked rows never marked a top-five row selected, although the reconciled ledger proves ATHERENERG opened between snapshots. The two-minute snapshot cadence therefore cannot reproduce the exact admission instant.

recommendations.description: Allows Momentum Runner candidates to open new simulation trades.
recommendations.rationale: Pause new Momentum Runner entries because its negative expectancy remains the dominant recurring setup-level loss in the trailing confidence window.
evidence: Affected group: all 30 Momentum Runner positions across 6 dates; 8 wins, INR -3,019.98 gross, INR 1,651.85 charges, INR -4,671.83 net, INR -155.73 expectancy, and profit factor 0.21.
Unaffected group: 62 other positions; INR 2,522.39 gross, INR 4,129.20 charges, and INR -1,606.81 net.
Five dates support pausing: July 27, July 28, July 29, July 31, and August 3. July 30 contradicts with INR 138.20 net; August 4 has no Momentum Runner transaction evidence.
The affected setup is negative on 5 of 6 dates containing relevant transactions, or 83.3%.
recommendations.risk: Pausing removes the profitable July 30 subgroup and any future recovery. August 4 itself had no Momentum Runner position, so this addresses recurring portfolio drag rather than that day's direct Rangebound loss.

validation.reason: High confidence: 30 affected transactions across 6 dates, strongly negative aggregate outcome, support on 83.3% of relevant dates, and only one small profitable contradictory date. This was not replay-tested or validated.

recommendations.description: Minimum rangebound gross move as a multiple of modeled costs.
recommendations.rationale: Research aligning the Rangebound-specific cost hurdle with the shared 2.5 multiple because charges converted positive gross movement into a net loss, but preserve 2.0 until entry-time cost evidence is stored.
evidence: Relevant setup population: 26 Rangebound positions across 3 dates; 9 wins, INR 1,156.48 gross, INR 1,340.63 charges, INR -184.15 net, INR -7.08 expectancy, and profit factor 0.94.
August 4 alone produced INR 74.24 gross but paid INR 561.38 in charges, ending INR -487.14 net.
Two relevant dates support a stricter cost hurdle: August 3 at INR -75.91 and August 4 at INR -487.14. July 31 contradicts with INR 378.90 net; four window dates have no Rangebound transactions.
Across the Rangebound population, 7 Target exits earned INR 2,397.96 net, while Stop, VWAP, Momentum fade, and No progress exits lost INR 2,801.29 net before the trailing winner.
recommendations.risk: The stored transaction does not record the expected gross-to-cost multiple seen at entry, so the exact affected count is unknown. A higher gate could reject profitable oscillations, including the positive July 31 subgroup, without fixing stop quality.

validation.reason: Low confidence despite 26 relevant transactions because the exact 2.0-to-2.5 affected subset cannot be reconstructed from stored fields. Preserve the current value pending direct entry-time mechanism evidence.
